newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pentex buys firm for S47.5 million.
newsitem.headline: Pentex buys firm for S47.5 million.

text.p: Singapore electronics firm Pentex-Schweuzer Circuits Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to buy a printed circuit board (PCB) making company for Singapore $47.5 million.
Pentex, which also produces PCBs, said it would pay cash for Degussa Electronics Ltd if shareholders approved the deal.
Pentex said Degussa was able to make multi-layer PCBs of up to 20 layers and its customers were mainly multi-national companies.
For the last financial year ended September 30 1996, Degussa recorded a net profit of S$4.69 million.
